text: Hello, and welcome! It's Wednesday, November 11. Time for the weather! Wednesday. We are halfway through the week! Here in Shanghai, the day will be grey from start to finish. It will reach 18 degrees, and drop down to 6 degrees. Nice and comfortable today, not too hot and not too cold. There is almost no chance of rain today. There are 43 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Grey skies are still good for the park. Bring your ball! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be damp with light drizzle, with a high of 22 degrees. This week we are thinking about warm drinks. Anything new today? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
